witness_description: No concrete witness can be evaluated because the quote does not define d(u) or relate it to the length of the displayed subpath.
refutation_explanation: The quote states that the prefix is shortest, but that fact alone does not determine the separately written quantity d(u). All 8 propositional truth assignments to the three quoted assertions were checked; the assignment (whole path shortest, prefix shortest, d(u) != delta(s,u)) shows the missing logical relation, but it is not a concrete graph counterexample without definitions for d and delta.
search_space: Exactly the 8 assignments in {False, True}^3, in itertools.product order, for: (P is shortest from s to v, its prefix is shortest from s to u, d(u) equals delta(s,u)). This is an exhaustive propositional diagnostic, not an exhaustive space of graphs.
